_provenance.dataQuality: SEEDED FROM PUBLISHED DATA: NHSE RTT full extract '20260430-RTT-April-2026-full-extract.csv' (RTT-April-2026), provider RX1 (NOTTINGHAM UNIVERSITY HOSPITALS NHS TRUST), aggregated over commissioners per treatment function. Wait bands give list and %<18wk; New RTT Periods give referral demand; completed admitted/non-admitted give clock stops and admitted share. LEVELS: flow levels are working-day-normalised means over RTT-February-2026, RTT-March-2026, RTT-April-2026 (standard 21-working-day month); census from RTT-April-2026. Operational parameters (day-case rate, cases/session, N:FU, LOS, diagnostics/referral) remain estimates. Folded into Other: X03 (Other - Mental Healths), C_300 (General Internal Medicine). ANOMALY FLAGS: 9 TFC(s) breach business rules (stops>referrals, referral step >25%/mo, implied negative removals) — flagged in the specialty table, not silently corrected.
